name: Melisron Ltd.
summary: Melisron Ltd. operates as a commercial real estate company in Israel. It operates through Income Producing Real Estate and Residential Development and Construction segments. The company engages in the purchase, construction, operation, rental, management, maintenance, and improvement of commercial centers, including regional, urban and neighbourhood malls and shopping centers; development, construction, owning, maintenance, and management of office complexes and hi-tech parks; residential development and construction, and urban renewal projects.
